THE LAWYER BEHIND THE TRACKER

Eric A. Hudson

Partner · Arambula Terrazas PLLC · Austin, Texas

Eric Hudson is a litigation partner at Arambula Terrazas PLLC with nearly two decades of experience in commercial litigation, constitutional disputes, injunctions, and appeals. He represents clients in state and federal courts and arbitration, including matters involving religious institutions and governmental action.

Before entering private practice, Eric served as a senior government litigator, handling complex constitutional, election, and public-law disputes. His practice combines trial advocacy with experience before the Texas Supreme Court, the Fifth Circuit, and the United States Supreme Court.

Religious liberty work in the news

Eric has represented Islamic schools and Muslim families seeking equal access to Texas Education Freedom Accounts. Houston Public Media and Texas Standard, Bloomberg Law, and the Fort Worth Star-Telegram reported on the federal court’s extension of the application window. Baptist News Global and public radio coverage of the voucher awards reported on the schools’ admission and the continuing dispute. In July, Eric told The Texas Tribune and ProPublica, “Religious liberty is not a temporary pass issued after a lawsuit.”

Eric has also represented Community Capital Partners, the developer of The Meadow, formerly EPIC City, in disputes over government investigations and land use. He raised due process concerns about a federal housing investigation in The Texas Tribune’s reporting. In coverage by KERA News about a state lawsuit, Eric described what he saw as “religious discrimination dressed up as land use enforcement.” KERA also covered the land use dispute, the developer’s agreement with a state agency, and the dispute over a court order. An October Houston Chronicle column quoted Eric’s statement about the actions of multiple state offices.
